disclaimer: everybody's skin is different. This didn't work for me and my needs. Context: I don't really use this as makeup remover, except for mascara and brow gel. I use it on my combination skin to wash off oil at the end of the day. This cleanser took the oil off my skin, but I didn't feel like it did much beyond that. My ideal oil cleanser penetrates the subaceous filaments on my nose, and I didn't feel like I got that here, even after like ~2 minutes of massaging it in. My other qualm is that this formula is somehow super dry? It has very minimal slip so I need 2-3 pumps, and it somehow still feels almost gritty. It does wash off super well and doesn't seem to have fragrance, so if you're looking for a topical wash, this would be good for you.

Formula is not smooth enough to use dry. Drags on the skin a lot more than other oil cleansers do. It emulsified fine and didn't smell strong. But as a standalone product, it was not very nice to use. You can find other cleansers with more product, and better quality at the same price.
